peopleAlsoAsk.question: What are some typical art skills for a 5-year-old?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: At this age, children have more control over the direction and size of the lines they draw and are able to copy shapes (triangles, squares) and print some letters and numbers. They also have more control of their art tools (pencils, markers, brushes, scissors). Five-year-olds are curious and inquisitive.
